title: garments round 8: separated collar, lapel and top references as shape truths

summary.recommended: Land step 1: the separated references and the shape-truth checks. The top without the collar and bow (top_layers) passes its refcheck in every view (iou_dc 0.965-0.996). The collar alone (collar_ghost) passes in front, three-quarter and back, but not profile (0.656). The new checks are calibrated. Hold the lapel rebuild: the truth-read flat lapels lift the collar truth in front (0.771 -> 0.89-0.91) and open the V (0.56 -> 0.77), but every row drops the in-context collar in three-quarter and profile by 17-27% and makes collar_three_quarter_torn FAIL.
asked: nothing: informational (the next round starts on the three-quarter lapels; the notes hold the plan)

rows: V skin front / 3q (remeasured to the V's point)

notes: Separated references generated in 4 paid calls at n=2 (ledger), refchecked against the turnaround before registering. top_layers (the top without the collar and bow) passes in every view. collar_ghost (the collar alone, ghost-mannequin) passes in front, three-quarter and back; its profile isn't registered. The collar drawn on the bare base body fails (0.60 / 0.68 / 0.39 / 0.97): drawn over a different layer, it spreads over the bare shoulders. The bow ghosts and the existing bow_closeup fail. The bow covers everything and nothing covers it, so the turnaround is its own shape truth.

Shape truths are in the manifest (shape_truth, beside the hair's): the collar and lapels without the bow, the bodice panel, the top without the collar and bow, the V's skin, and the collar alone. New checks: collar_{front,three_quarter}_truth (calibrated: the flagged bunched lapels fail at 0.617 / 0.514; the design moved reads >= 0.927) and top_{view}_truth (guards). Remeasured: neck_v_*_skin, against the V's truth with ours drawn without the bow, down to the V's point.

The collar's two measures, reconciled. The truth agrees with the turnaround wherever both see the collar; the only differences are 1-2 px ink lines. The guard reads the drawn collar (0.993 against the hand truth). The bows match at 0.77 / 0.68. The truth-read lapels' inner edges cut into the drawn V's skin near the neck, and both measures see that. The truth still rises because the lapels now continue under the bow.

art_terminator_neck: the chin shadow is intact (face_shadow_chin 0.69 -> 0.62; under the board light the neck's shadow share is 0.13 / 0.15 / 0.14, against the design's 0.13-0.16). Only the artifact detector's numpy neck window turned one tone; its acceptance record is amended.
